$comment: p15-oracle-067: the tab family (tab, tab_group, saved_tab_group, closed; 21 mutations); gen_daemon_ops.py reads this file, run it after an edit. Each success makes a change the snapshot shows, and each error is the handler's or router's own refusal, named in its note, where one is reachable. Close and reopen run as round trips: closed.reopen and closed.delete close the split's tab first (a before step), saved_tab_group.reopen closes the live group first, so the closed history and the saved record are what the call acts on. tab.create_browser keeps the catalog check's error: on a daemon with no browser engine the engine gate (resource_router.rs dispatch, browser_engine.rs refuse_without_provider) answers engine_unavailable before any handler, so only the catalog refusal is the same on both products.

success.note: the closed group the before step made leaves the history (deleted names it)

details.reason: name exactly one of closed or all

error.note: closed_history_delete.rs DeleteRequest::validate refuses closed together with all and deletes nothing

success.note: round trip: the tab (and its pane) the before step closed comes back from the newest closed group

error.note: nothing was closed, so there is no newest closed group (closed_history.rs state_reopen_closed)
a saved group id that names no record deletes nothing and succeeds (deleted false), so the refusal is a revision the session never reached: nothing is written

success.note: round trip: the live group closes, and its saved record opens it again as a new group in the split's pane

error.note: a saved group id that names no record (tabs.rs state_reopen_saved_tab_group)
a room id that names no room: the router refuses it before the group is saved

success.note: the split's only tab closes, and its pane with it; the workspace keeps its first pane

error.note: a well-formed tab id that names no tab: nothing closes and no closed group is recorded (closing the home's last tab is no error: emptied_workspace.rs keeps the home, empty)

success.gap: no product runs it yet: the daemon product has no browser engine (engine_unavailable before the handler), and driver_app.py hands resource.call to driver_daemon.py; p15-oracle-239 runs requires-chromium cases on the app product's own daemon, whose browser host is the provider
success.note: a daemon-rendered browser tab opens in the fixture pane

error.note: url breaks its catalog type (value has too few UTF-8 bytes); the catalog check refuses it before the engine gate, so the refusal is the same with and without a browser engine

success.note: a named terminal tab opens in the fixture pane

error.note: a well-formed pane id that names no pane: nothing opens

success.note: focus moves from the split's tab back to the first pane's tab

error.note: a well-formed tab id that names no tab: focus does not move
a destination pane id that names no pane: the tab stays
a well-formed tab id that names no tab: nothing is pinned

success.note: the tab gets a user name

error.note: a well-formed tab id that names no tab: nothing is renamed

success.note: round trip: the tab the before step pinned is unpinned

error.note: a well-formed tab id that names no tab: nothing is unpinned

success.note: zoom and the unread mark of a terminal tab change in one commit

details.reason: back and forward apply only to browser tabs

error.note: a terminal tab has no browser history: tabs.rs state_update_tab refuses back and writes nothing

success.note: the split's tab joins the group and moves into the group's pane

error.note: a pinned tab cannot join a group (tab_groups.rs tab_group_add); the group keeps its members
a group id that names no group: no tab closes

success.note: a named blue group of the fixture tab

details.reason: tab group members must share one pane

error.note: tabs of two panes cannot form one group (tab_groups.rs tab_group_create); no group is made

success.note: the group and its tab move to the front of the split's pane

error.note: a pane id that names no live pane (tabs.rs state_move_tab_group): the group stays
a well-formed tab id that names no tab (tabs.rs resolve_tabs): no tab leaves its group
a group id that names no group: nothing is ungrouped

success.note: name, color and collapsed of the group change in one commit

error.note: a group id that names no group: nothing changes
